notes.title: An Emergency Patch Has Been Issued
notes.content: You know how you try to fix one simple thing, and then break a bunch of other things? I do! If you played the game following the patch that went up around Midnight PST on 09/10 until this fix was issued around 3:30PM PST on 09/11, you may have found some cutscenes refusing to play, and some floors completely impassible. This has been resolved.

notes.title: Chapter 1 Demo: Definitive Edition
notes.content:
The Chapter 1 Demo of Firebird: Legend of the Crystal Goddesses has received a HUGE overhaul to bring it up-to-date with the current development version of the game. These changes include:

 • The game has been reformatted from a 4:3 aspect ratio to 16:9 fullscreen.
 • The combat system has been completely rebalanced, including equipment stats.
 • Quality-of-Life improvements, such as story-unlocked dungeon-escape and fast-travel systems.
 • More world lore has been added to main story dialogue to enrich the narrative experience.
 • Books are no longer collectible items. To avoid inventory bloat, books are read where they are.
 • Many graphical assets have been updated and improved, and to align with the new 16:9 formatting.
 • Brand new Official Store & Library Art for the game, courtesy of CerasusArts on Twitch.

If you've played it before, play it again! You will find a more robust experience than ever! And, as before, do try to go for 100% completion (now trackable in-game) to unlock the FULL epilogue to Chapter 1!
